_readme: Single source of truth for the resume. Consumed by frontend/pages/Landing.jsx (the web page) and by resume_pdf_generator.py (the PDF, generated at build time by build.sh). Edit this file only. Never edit the page or the generator to change content, or the two will drift the way they did before this file existed. Formatting differences between the page and the PDF are intentional and live in each renderer: dates are stored ISO here and formatted per target. The private master record this file is a filtered view of lives in ~/Documents/Notes/job-search/experience/.
_pdfFlag: Any work or project entry may set "pdf": false to appear on the website but not in the PDF. The web page has unlimited room; the PDF has to stay at two pages. Default when the key is absent is true.

profile.summary: Product engineer, full stack and applied AI. I build and own production products end to end with React, TypeScript, Node and Python, and I take AI features from 0 to 1: retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and vector search, fine-tuning, and guards against prompt injection and hallucination. I ran production releases and mentored developers at Equator, and ran my own studio before that. I work through coding agents (Claude Code) daily, plan first, and review every diff before it ships.

work.tech: Node.js/Express, React, Next.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, Python/FastAPI, OpenAI, Qdrant, ChromaDB, GeoPandas, Docker, GitLab CI/CD, AWS, Linux
bullets: Built a 0 to 1 AI proposal product as its sole engineer through the initial build, then led it as the team grew to seven, authoring the majority of commits and 64% of the code.

Rebuilt the marketing site on Next.js and owned it end to end through CI/CD and release, growing organic search from under 1,000 clicks and under 1M impressions to 52.1K clicks and 6.17M impressions in six months.
Authored and merged 70 production releases on the AI product, and served as release manager for a main-product release, coordinating the rollout through pre- and post-push testing.
Built the RAG ingestion and retrieval pipeline on OpenAI embeddings and Qdrant, migrated off ChromaDB, using query-expansion retrieval rather than single-vector search.
Implemented a client model fine-tuning pipeline on the OpenAI fine-tuning API, and a proxy metering token cost per user on every model call.
Built an admin prompt orchestration layer so non-engineers tune production AI behaviour live, with versioned code-defined fallbacks and prompt-injection and hallucination guards.
Integrated server-hosted GIS segmentation models (SamGeo, LangSAM) for satellite imagery selection in the main app.
Added Stripe payment systems and supported site-based pricing rollout with product.
Onboarded and mentored 2 full-time developers, reviewed 55 merge requests, and set written acceptance criteria on work handed off to them.
Created and decomposed 2 company epics, sat on interview panels, and held the architecture decision on the AI product and the frontend.
Wrote and maintained the team developer handbook, commit and merge-request policy, and engineering principles with a self-review checklist.

work.tech: React, Node.js, Django, Python, Blender API, HTML/CSS/JavaScript, AWS
bullets: Founded and ran a federally incorporated 3D modeling and rendering contract pipeline studio across 7 client engagements with no outside funding; owned product, clients, contracts, and delivery end to end.
Built per-client combinatorial rule engines and unattended batch rendering on rented GPU capacity, delivering over 50,000 rendered files to one client in under a week.
Open-sourced the studio's Blender tooling (see Projects) and grew a companion tutorial channel to 282,388 views and 3.29K subscribers across 25 videos, driving adoption.

work.tech: JavaScript/TypeScript, TestCafe, Node/npm, Git, Jira, WCAG
bullets: Built TestCafe regression suites in TypeScript/JavaScript, reducing manual cycles and improving release confidence.
Performed WCAG accessibility audits and partnered with engineers/PMs to ship compliant releases; triaged defects within CI workflows.

Delivered manual and automated testing as a contractor for clients including TunnelBear, Hubba, THRILLWORKS, and Hopscotch, building reusable test tooling and cross-browser checklists for WCAG-aligned releases.
